final_message:
I rewrote the skill's description. I haven't tested it yet, so I don't know whether agents will load the skill now.

**Why it never loaded:** before a skill triggers, an agent sees only its name and description. This one said `Helps with parquet files.`, which gives an agent about to write a parquet file nothing to match against.

**What I changed:** I edited only the `description` line in `skills/parquet-schema-check/SKILL.md` and left the body alone. The new description lists the moments when the skill should load:

> Use when about to write, save, export or overwrite a parquet file (pandas to_parquet, pyarrow write_table, polars write_parquet, Spark df.write.parquet), or when adding, renaming, reordering or retyping columns of a dataset that has a schema in schemas/. Also use when a job reading parquet fails with a schema mismatch, missing column or dtype error.

- It names the actual write calls and the column changes that break a schema. Agents match on those words.
- It doesn't describe the check itself. If a description summarizes the steps, agents tend to follow the summary and skip the body, which here says not to cast columns to make them match.
- It's about 370 characters, under the 500 recommended and well under the 1024 cap. That matters because Claude Code drops whole descriptions when its skill listing runs out of room.

**Testing still to do:** I could only read and edit files this turn, so I couldn't start fresh sessions. The test is:
1. Write at least 3 prompts that should load the skill (e.g. "add a `region` column to the orders frame and save it to parquet").
2. Write at least 3 near misses, like reading a parquet file or writing a CSV.
3. Run each one in a fresh session with the old description and again with the new one, and count how many times the skill loads.

The fix works if the should-load count goes up and the near-miss count doesn't. To test with the skill turned off, set its `skillOverrides` entry to `off`.

**Also noted:** the frontmatter has no `license` field, which the writing-skills checklist requires. I didn't find a license or a frontmatter lint anywhere in this repo, so I didn't make one up. Tell me which license to use if you want one.
